p: prepare thee a way: Make an open and ready way.
slayer may flee thither: Who killed against his will, and bore no hatred in his heart.
shall flee unto one of those: That murder not be committed on murder.
enlarge thy coast: When you go over Jordan to possess the whole land of Canaan.
so blood be upon thee: Lest you be punished for innocent blood.
elders of his city shall send: The magistrates.
eye shall not pity him: Then whoever pardons murder, goes against the word of God.
LORD: God's presence where his true ministers are assembled.
